import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib.offsetbox import HPacker, VPacker, DrawingArea
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

da1 = DrawingArea(10, 20)   # short
da2 = DrawingArea(10, 30)   # tall
ren = plt.gcf().canvas.get_renderer()

print("HPacker (children heights 20,30):")
for align in ["top", "bottom", "center", "baseline"]:
    pack = HPacker(children=[da1, da2], pad=0, sep=0, align=align)
    w, h, xd, yd, offs = pack.get_extent_offsets(ren)
    y = [round(float(o[1]), 2) for o in offs]
    print(f"  align={align!r:10} yoffsets={y}  (child1 y, child2 y)")

print("VPacker (children widths 20,30 via DrawingArea(20,10)/DrawingArea(30,10)):")
va1, va2 = DrawingArea(20, 10), DrawingArea(30, 10)
for align in ["left", "right", "center"]:
    pack = VPacker(children=[va1, va2], pad=0, sep=0, align=align)
    w, h, xd, yd, offs = pack.get_extent_offsets(ren)
    x = [round(float(o[0]), 2) for o in offs]
    print(f"  align={align!r:10} xoffsets={x}")
EOF

da1, da2 = DrawingArea(10, 20), DrawingArea(10, 30)
ren = plt.gcf().canvas.get_renderer()
res = {}
for a in ["top", "bottom"]:
    pack = HPacker(children=[da1, da2], pad=0, sep=0, align=a)
    *_, offs = pack.get_extent_offsets(ren)
    res[a] = [round(float(o[1]), 2) for o in offs]
assert res["top"][0] > 0 and res["top"][1] == 0, res      # short child lifted to top
assert res["bottom"] == [0.0, 0.0], res                  # both at bottom
print("align semantics verified:", res)
